title: Add RBACv2 liveness prober and operator region-pin enforcement
author: Maya Nguyen
description: Motivation: We observed two incidents where operator role bindings granted cross-region access for short-lived operators because stale RBAC policies and rollout glitches bypassed residency checks. This PR introduces two safety mechanisms: 1) an RBACv2 liveness prober that periodically validates active role bindings against residency constraints and configuration (detecting stale/invalid bindings), and 2) a strict operator-region pin enforcement path that denies or rewrites operator-scoped tokens when the request's KMS region contradicts the tenant or service region policy. The change is guarded behind a feature flag (rbacv2.liveness_prober.enabled) and staged rollout configuration for operator roles so we can enable per-namespace enforcement during the canary. The description below is an implementation summary and rollout guidance.

review_comments: Diego Alvarez (requested changes): The prober currently lists bindings by last_applied_timestamp — please switch to using the policy revision id to avoid races during reconciliations.
Maya Nguyen (author reply): Updated to compare policy_revision and added a short-circuit for namespace-scoped policies to avoid noisy alerts.
Priya Shah (comment): We need an integration test that simulates a KMS region mismatch when token proxying occurs; the current unit tests don't cover admission-path rewrites.
Maya Nguyen (author reply): Added tests/integration/rbac_region_pin_test.go that exercises token admission and KMS region validator with a mocked KMS endpoint.
release_notes:
- Add RBACv2 liveness prober to detect stale/invalid role bindings that violate residency constraints.
- Enforce operator region-pin checks during admission; operator tokens with KMS region mismatch are rejected or rewritten according to rollout policy.
- Feature guarded by rbacv2.liveness_prober.enabled and helm values for staged rollout.
- Adds integration tests and helm configuration for canary enables.
notes_for_ops: Default behaviour is disabled. To enable in a controlled canary: 1) set rbacv2.liveness_prober.enabled=true in the operator helm values for the canary namespace, 2) set operator_region_pin.mode=warn for initial phase, then enforce=deny after monitoring, 3) ensure KMS clients expose region claim for tokens. Monitor new metric rbac.liveness_prober.alerts and operator.region_pin.rejections.
security_impact: Moderate: tightens residency enforcement and reduces risk of cross-region operator escalation. If enabled without KMS region claims deployed, operator workflows may be rejected — rollout guidance required.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for policy checker and region validator. Integration test mocks KMS region responses and verifies admission path rejection and token rewrite behaviour. CI flake: initially failed one integration test (timeout), rerun passed.
